note: EVALUATION / DESIGN NOTES ONLY. Ground truth and expected behaviour for scoring this scenario. Never loaded by the running app and never shown to an agent; read only by tests (backend/tests/fake_llm.py) and eval scripts.

ground_truth_cause.text: Simulated haemorrhage starting after clipping and cutting, in a patient on apixaban. The propofol target increase 25 s before the segment is a deliberate confounder.

surgical: Omni answer on last 10 s of video, if available

surgical.gist: Pressure began falling about 20 s after cutting, and suction/irrigation then bipolar appeared out of the usual order.

anesthesia.gist: Propofol target was raised about 70 s before the fall began; but HR is rising, which a propofol effect alone does not usually explain.

record.gist: Patient takes apixaban, last dose about 19 h before incision; anti-Xa level not sent; pre-op Hb 11.2 g/dL.

expected_convergence.note: Main demo beat (build plan section 6). Acceptable alternative: converged on bleeding_concern if the anesthesia agent moves to unclear in round 2.

expected_sentinel_output.team_question: Two explanations fit: possible bleeding (just after clipping and cutting; suction and bipolar now in use; apixaban 19 h ago) and drug effect (propofol increase about 85 s before the alert). Check the field for bleeding and confirm the drug timing.

scoring.correct_explanation_if: bleeding_concern is shown (shared view or one side of a split)
